remarks: Moments from the vibrant energy of SoNo, this beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom condo offers a seamless blend of comfort and convenience. Sunlight pours through oversized windows, highlighting the warmth of gleaming hardwood floors and a thoughtfully designed layout that balances openness with defined spaces. The kitchen, both functional and inviting, provides ample storage and prep space, while two well-proportioned bedrooms offer flexibility for rest, work, or creative pursuits. With two dedicated garage parking spaces, everyday living becomes effortless. Just beyond your doorstep, the waterfront, renowned dining, and the curated retail experience of The SoNo Collection invite exploration, offering the perfect harmony of urban vibrancy and coastal charm.
